rows.grounds: compound of śiva, ākāśa, and vinirmukta; denotes what is freed from śiva-space
compound of mūla and nāśana; denotes destruction of the root

items.question: What is the nature of the space freed from śiva-space?
items.inference: The space beyond śiva-space is impenetrable and brings about root-destruction.
uncertainties: exact referent of root-destruction remains unresolved
items.plain_english: The space freed from śiva-space is impenetrable and is root-destruction.
